input.query:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(timestamp, '%H:%i:%S.%f', 'UTC') AS started_utc,
    multiIf(match(coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_span_id), ''), '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'),
        toString(properties.$ai_span_id), 'invalid_or_missing') AS span_id,
    multiIf(match(coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_parent_id), ''), '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'),
        toString(properties.$ai_parent_id), 'invalid_or_missing') AS parent_span_id,
    1000 * toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_latency)) AS latency_ms,
    1000 * toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_time_to_first_token)) AS ttft_ms,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_input_tokens)) AS input_tokens,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_output_tokens)) AS output_tokens,
    multiIf(toString(properties.$ai_is_error) IN ('1', 'true'), 'error',
        toString(properties.$ai_is_error) IN ('0', 'false'), 'ok', 'unknown') AS error_state
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND event = '$ai_generation'
    AND properties.$ai_trace_id = '{{trace_id_hex}}'
ORDER BY timestamp, uuid
LIMIT 20
input.context: Actual production #1512 trace-scoped metadata-only display validation; fixed <=1-hour UTC window; at most20 rows.
